title: Comprehensive assessment of phytotoxic effects, morphology, chemical compositions, and water retention capacities of biochars
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,3459-3472
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00005J, Paper
Open Access

Hassan El Moussaoui, Zaina Idardare, Laila Bouqbis
Increasing organic waste requires sustainable recycling methods. Converting it into biochar offers a viable solution, as its physicochemical and phytotoxic properties vary with feedstock and process, affecting water retention and agricultural safety.
